intended_object: The top element of the poset of open normal subgroups U of a profinite group G whose quotient G/U is a finite p-group. This is U = G, which gives the trivial quotient G/G and is trivially a p-group. Inferred from the docstring and from its use as `top` in the `OrderTop` instance on `Quotient p G`.
explanation:
`Quotient p G` is the library's type of open normal subgroups U of G for which G ⧸ U is a p-group. These are the kernels in the inverse system whose limit defines the maximal pro-p quotient.

`top` takes the whole group, `topOpenNormal G` (the subgroup ⊤, which is open because it is `univ`). The p-group condition holds because G ⧸ ⊤ is a subsingleton, and a trivial group is a p-group. So this is the trivial quotient G/G, which is the greatest element for the order inherited from `OpenNormalSubgroup`. The `OrderTop` instance confirms this use.

This matches the docstring. Nothing in it is degenerate or wrongly specified, and it is stated at the generality of the surrounding construction: any profinite group and any prime p. Mathlib has no separate declaration of this specific bundled object.
